description: A second sheet beside the theme's copy, `libs/components/themes/print.css`, gains an `@media (orientation: portrait)` block, and 1.3.4 keeps resting on the scan. The package ships every top-level file of that folder (`assets` in `ng-package.json`, glob `*`), and the reader leaves out the copy alone, `themes/pct.css`: a reader that left out the folder finds none. Laid on disk and read by the live reader (`tree`).
